name: Ian Machado Garry
photo_coverage: 12 photos, 8 of them from UFC 330 fight week (Aug 2026), so recency is very good. Frontal: UFC studio headshot (Aug 2026), media day and press conference (Aug 2026). Three-quarter: UFC 330 press table. Profile: UFC 310 face-off (right side, near 90 degrees, Dec 2024) and UFC 330 face-off (right side, about 70 degrees). Body: studio cutouts from Aug 2026 and Apr 2025, plus weigh-ins. One Commons photo (CC BY-SA 4.0, 2023), small.

face.shape: Long, narrow-to-medium face with a tall skull; rectangular-oval, with an angular lower face. Widest at the cheekbones and jaw angles, which are about the same width.
face.jaw: Angular, clean jaw line with defined jaw angles; moderately wide for the narrow face.
face.chin: Long and fairly prominent, slightly squared, projecting a little in profile; covered by a sparse goatee in 2026.
face.cheekbones: Moderate, not wide; the cheeks below are lean and slightly hollow.
face.brow_ridge: Fairly strong and straight, so the eyes look deep-set and shadowed under top light.
face.forehead: High and broad, made taller by mild temple recession; smooth, slopes back slightly in profile.

eyes.shape: Medium almond eyes, slightly hooded by the low brow; outer corners level. Deep-set.
eyes.colour: Light grey-blue with a hint of green (grey-blue in the press-conference photo, grey-green under warmer light).
eyes.size: Medium; look smaller under the brow shadow.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes, with a slight downward angle at the outer ends; meets close to the nose (narrow gap).
eyebrows.colour: Medium brown, darker than the buzz-cut hair reads.

nose.width: Narrow to medium bridge; the tip and nostril wings are moderately wide.
nose.hump: None; a straight line from bridge to tip.
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly bulbous, turned very slightly up in profile; projects well.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, with a soft cupid's bow; often pressed in a smirk.
mouth.lower_lip: Medium, fuller than the upper lip.
mouth.resting_expression: Confident closed-mouth smirk, one corner slightly higher; neutral face has level corners.
mouth.teeth: Straight, even upper teeth when talking (UFC 330 face-off).

ears.protrusion: Clearly protruding from the head (stand out at the top and middle), very visible with the buzz cut.
ears.notes: Ears are a recognition cue with the short hair; keep them standing out.

face.notable_marks_scars: Freckles across the nose, cheeks and forehead (clear in the studio headshot). A small dark spot on the right cheek in the Aug 2026 press-conference photo (mole or freckle, low confidence). No scars visible.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, about 6-10 mm all over, slightly longer on top; no fade line. In May 2025 the buzz cut was bleached blond.
hair.colour: Light brown to dark blond with a warm golden/ginger cast; the scalp shows through, so the head reads light tan-brown.
hair.colour_note: Samples include scalp showing through the buzz cut; #94705a is the strand colour estimate (a little darker than the samples, lighter than the brows).
hair.hairline: Mild recession at both temples (soft M shape); full in the centre.

facial_hair.colour: Light brown, a touch redder than the head hair.
facial_hair.colour_note: Visual estimate: the hairs are too sparse for a clean pixel sample (point samples land on skin).
facial_hair.density: Sparse. Light moustache stubble, a small soul patch and a thin chin strip; cheeks and jaw clean-shaven or light stubble.
facial_hair.shape: Narrow goatee: soul patch joined to a chin strip, with a faint moustache. In the Aug 2026 studio headshot the moustache and chin are just stubble.

skin.sampling_method: Median of a 5-9 px box per spot, checked on an overlay sheet. Clipped or highlight samples are listed but excluded.
skin.tone_note: Very fair. Flash shots push him pink; daylight reads more peach. #e3a892 is the suggested render albedo.
skin.undertone: Cool-to-neutral pink; flushes red on the cheeks, nose and ears under exertion and flash.
skin.freckles_marks: Scattered light-brown freckles on the nose, cheeks, forehead and shoulders. Light chest hair in the centre of the chest and a thin trail below the navel.
skin.texture_pick: young_caucasian_male (swatch #e6b393) tinted toward #e3a892, with a freckle overlay if available.

body.build: Tall and lanky with a long torso and long legs. His reach (188 cm) is slightly shorter than his height (190.5 cm), so the arms are a touch short for his frame; do not stretch them.
body.body_fat_note: Lean with visible upper abs at fight week; the studio cutouts show a little softness below the navel. Not shredded.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad, squared, with rounded but modest deltoids.
body.chest: Moderate, fairly flat pecs; not bulky.
body.arms: Long, lean arms with modest biceps and visible forearm veins.
body.waist: Narrow but straight; only a mild V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Long legs, slim thighs, thin calves.
body.posture: Upright and tall, chest open, chin often raised slightly; shoulders relaxed and square. Arms hang straight with fists loosely closed in the studio cutouts.
body.notable_physique_traits: Tall lanky frame, long torso, fair freckled skin, small scattered fine-line tattoos rather than large pieces.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, skin, tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions (two good profiles and several 2026 frontals); low-to-medium for exact morph values. What to watch: (1) The likeness rests on the long face and tall skull, high forehead with mild temple recession, low straight brows over deep-set light eyes, a long straight nose and a long chin. (2) Ears stick out; with a buzz cut they are very visible. (3) Very fair, pink, freckled skin; flash photos exaggerate the pink, so use tone_hex_recommended. (4) Hair is a 6-10 mm buzz cut, light brown (bleached blond in May 2025). (5) Thin upper lip, smirk, sparse narrow goatee. (6) Tall and lanky, arms slightly short for his height; modest chest. (7) Tattoos are small and scattered (cherub pair high on the chest, text lines, forearm words); none is a sleeve, so do not render sleeves. Macro ageOldM 0.046 uses (28-25)/65 (he turns 29 on 2026-11-17). heightUpM 0.3 is a guess for 190.5 cm; the avatar scales to official height. Values symmetric; l-/r- refer to the character's own sides.
